query:
MATCH p =
  (a:Group)-[:SCCM_CoerceAndRelayToSMB]->(b:Computer)
WHERE a.name CONTAINS 'AUTHENTICATED USERS'
AND b.SMBSigningRequired = false
RETURN p
name: SCCM ELEVATE-1
description: Find potential SCCM SMB coercion-and-relay paths from Authenticated Users to computers that do not require SMB signing.
